title: Spinach and Feta Pie
summary: A Greek-style savoury pie with tender spinach, salty feta and herbs in a buttery crust. It’s comforting and golden, ideal for a relaxed vegetarian dinner.
steps: Make the pastry first: rub the cold butter into the flour with your fingertips until it looks like fine crumbs. Stir in the egg and cold water, then bring it together into a dough. Wrap and chill for 20 minutes.
While the dough chills, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 to 6 minutes until soft and translucent, then add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add the spinach in batches and cook until wilted. If there is a lot of liquid in the pan, keep cooking until it has evaporated. Set aside to cool slightly.
Squeeze any excess moisture from the spinach, then mix it with the feta, dill, parsley, nutmeg, black pepper and salt.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Roll out two-thirds of the pastry and use it to line a pie dish, leaving a little overhang.
Spoon in the spinach and feta filling. Roll out the remaining pastry, cover the pie and pinch the edges to seal. Cut a small steam hole in the top.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the pastry is deep golden and crisp. Leave to rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
